en-US:
No more dead plants.
They'll text you first.

Just say what you did.
Everyone gets the memo.

Frost, heat or a trip?
Your plants are covered.

Yellow leaves?
We'll tell you why.

Snap a plant or a label.
We'll figure it out.

Share the jungle.
No more double watering.

Your whole week,
sorted in one look.

Your jungle,
right on your Home Screen.

Erty's got your back.
Plus unlocks it all.
